title: Don Halloween suit, all 15 existing poses

assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: ONE transparent PNG character cutout for an animated comedy hockey broadcast, full untrimmed 1254 x 1254 canvas.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the exact existing Don robot default pose. Create a Halloween wardrobe variant by changing ONLY his jacket's fabric print and his necktie colours.
Costume: the same flamboyant tailored suit silhouette and lapels, now rich midnight-purple fabric lavishly patterned with vivid pumpkin-orange jack-o-lanterns, small ivory ghosts and black bats, with elegant orange curling vine flourishes. Motifs are bold, handsome and readable at broadcast size; make it a coherent bespoke Halloween suit rather than a costume or armour. A black-and-pumpkin-orange diagonally striped tie. Keep the white shirt, white cuffs, white pocket square and small black lapel microphone exactly as in the edit target. Do not add hat, mask, props, scenery or any other Halloween accessories.
Preserve ALL other pixels and geometry as closely as possible: silver faceted robot face, glowing cyan screen eyes, sculpted white-metal hair, connected white moustache wrapping into the broad chin goatee, closed mouth, facial expression, both clasped silver robot hands, every finger, body scale, exact head position and size, shoulder anchors, camera angle, lower cut and margins. Seated left host facing slightly screen-right, never mirrored. Same polished detailed cel-shaded illustration and lighting. Leave the head, hands and white shirt unchanged.
Background: real transparent alpha, including holes between arms and body, full untrimmed square canvas. No desk, no surface, no chair, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no watermark. One pose only. Keep original alignment so the new image can replace this pose in the same animation without jumping.
assets.postprocessing: Raw generated PNG copied byte-for-byte. WebP exports use quality 94, full canvas at 1254 and 640 pixels. AVIF generated by npm run coachs:assets.
